articles.title: John von Neumann
articles.lead: One of the fathers of computer architecture.
articles.body:
John von Neumann was born in Budapest in 1903.

His name is attached to the stored-program computer, known today as the von Neumann architecture.

articles.title: Campanella 0.0.1 is out
articles.body:
Object, Blueprint, Capability, Query and Presentation: that is all the first version has.

Everything else is built on this core.

articles.title: Capabilities in brief
articles.body:
An object is an article because of its capabilities: Titled, Textual, Routable, Publishable.

A type is only a named bundle of capabilities: a Blueprint.
